claims.claim_text: The SAFE converts only on an Equity Financing, defined as a sale of Capital Stock raising at least $1,000,000 cash. Conversion is at the lower of the lowest price paid in the round (if pre-money is at or below the cap) or the SAFE Price (cap divided by Fully Diluted Capitalization). Fully Diluted Capitalization excludes all SAFEs, convertible notes and their conversion shares.

critical_items.note: Form C XML and the Form C PDF agree on issuer, intermediary, target, maximum and deadline.
A Series 2026 SAFE, issued through a custodian/nominee structure.

The Exhibit B form of SAFE (doc 6 pp. 55-66) is in the pack. It is an unsigned form. Exhibits C and D are unsigned templates, and the custodian entity is named inconsistently (A18). Whether conversion is automatic is also inconsistent across documents (A19). Not independently legally reviewed.
$1.00 per unit and a single $15,000,000 pre-money cap from the SAFE text. No discount or tiered cap was found. The cap denominator excludes SAFEs (A11, A12).

Minimum $100, maximum $124,000 and issuer-paid intermediary fees are cited. Any investor-side platform or custodian fees were not found in the pack. The checklist says investor fees must be confirmed by the user at approval. The Exhibit C custodian fee schedule is blank.
Reviewed (unaudited) FY2025 and FY2024 statements are included with a going-concern paragraph. The June 30, 2026 cash figure is an issuer claim only.
No platform page or closing evidence is in the pack. Only the Form C deadline of 2026-12-18 and an issuer press release saying the campaign is 'live'. A future deadline is not proof of availability.

missing_information: Platform (Republic) deal page, live funding status, amount raised so far and closing evidence; availability could not be verified.
Investor-side fees (platform or custodian charges). The BitGo fee schedule in Exhibit C is blank.
Signed or final versions of the custodian agreement and the nominee trust agreement, and clarification of which BitGo entity is the custodian.
Cap table detail: option pool, outstanding options or warrants, and pro forma ownership after conversion of existing SAFEs at the same $15M cap.
Existing SAFE terms (any caps below $15M, discounts or MFN) beyond the single 2022 $15M-cap series in the notes.
Interim 2026 financial statements and the breakdown of the $654,000 June 30, 2026 balance (cash versus marketable securities).
Monthly revenue and gross margin trend, and customer, retailer and Amazon concentration. Support for the claimed 1800 doors and $100K monthly run rate.
Terms of the Wayflyer facility and any recurring need for revenue-based financing.
Any concurrent private raise, which is mentioned in the Form C but not detailed.
Independent corroboration of any claim: the pack contains only issuer-prepared documents. Exhibit E pages 111-127 and 132-150 are blank or have no text.
Whether the pre-filing 'live' press release (Sept 24) complied with Reg CF rules; this is a legal question not answered in the pack.
